ext.name: AwakeTab — Keep your screen awake
ext.description: Keep your screen on with one click. A calm clock shows the time left. 46 faces, all free — no account, no tracking.
ext.command.toggle: Start or stop keeping the screen awake
ext.fix.aria: See the fix on awaketab.com, in a new tab
ext.foot.open.aria: Open the full AwakeTab app in a new tab
ext.noAnswer: AwakeTab didn’t answer. Close this popup and open it again.
ext.options.title: AwakeTab extension · Options
ext.options.badge: Show time left on the icon
ext.options.badge.desc: The badge counts down in minutes
ext.options.auto.desc: Starts when one of the sites below opens
ext.options.hidden: Release when the tab is hidden
ext.options.hidden.desc: Saves battery; resumes when you come back
ext.options.noSite: Click the AwakeTab icon while you are on the site, then add it here.
